Four wildly different criminal factions find their destinies colliding over a weekend of escalating chaos, misplaced loot, and bizarre philosophical debates. Told out of chronological order, this darkly comedic cult classic weaves together hitmen, boxers, and petty thieves in a stylish underworld labyrinth. As absurd misunderstandings and sudden violence intersect, each eccentric character hurtles toward an unforgettable, loop-closing finale.
